Florida single-family closed sales fell 10.1% in October to 19,049; median price rose 2.2% to $420,000, new pending sales dropped 15.7%
Sarasota County votes Nov 18 on 1,000 more homes at Palmer Ranch East — up to 5,702 homes total, including up to 500 attainable homes
Beacon Hill at Princeton opens with 112 workforce housing units in Miami-Dade — described as Florida's first ground-up Live Local Act development to complete
Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30
Copper trading near $6.00/lb Tue afternoon, consolidating near $5.88 support — AI data-center and grid-upgrade demand cited as structural driver
